translations.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
translations.ylt: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to a command of God our Saviour, and of the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,
translations.web: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

translations.kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
translations.ylt: to Timotheus--genuine child in faith: Grace, kindness, peace, from God our Father, and Christ Jesus our Lord,
translations.web: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

translations.kjv: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
translations.ylt: according as I did exhort thee to remain in Ephesus--I going on to Macedonia--that thou mightest charge certain not to teach any other thing,
translations.web: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

translations.kjv: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
translations.ylt: nor to give heed to fables and endless genealogies, that cause questions rather than the building up of God that is in faith: --
translations.web: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

translations.kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
translations.ylt: And the end of the charge is love out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned,
translations.web: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

translations.kjv: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
translations.ylt: from which certain, having swerved, did turn aside to vain discourse,
translations.web: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

translations.kjv: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
translations.ylt: willing to be teachers of law, not understanding either the things they say, nor concerning what they asseverate,
translations.web: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

translations.kjv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
translations.ylt: and we have known that the law is good, if any one may use it lawfully;
translations.web: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

translations.kjv: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
translations.ylt: having known this, that for a righteous man law is not set, but for lawless and insubordinate persons, ungodly and sinners, impious and profane, parricides and matricides, men-slayers,
translations.web: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

translations.kjv: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
translations.ylt: whoremongers, sodomites, men-stealers, liars, perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that to sound doctrine is adverse,
translations.web: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

translations.kjv: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
translations.ylt: according to the good news of the glory of the blessed God, with which I was entrusted.
translations.web: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

translations.kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
translations.ylt: And I give thanks to him who enabled me--Christ Jesus our Lord--that he did reckon me stedfast, having put me to the ministration,
translations.web: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

translations.kjv: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
translations.ylt: who before was speaking evil, and persecuting, and insulting, but I found kindness, because, being ignorant, I did it in unbelief,
translations.web: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

translations.kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: and exceedingly abound did the grace of our Lord, with faith and love that is in Christ Jesus:
translations.web: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
translations.ylt: stedfast is the word, and of all acceptation worthy, that Christ Jesus came to the world to save sinners--first of whom I am;
translations.web: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

translations.kjv: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
translations.ylt: but because of this I found kindness, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all long-suffering, for a pattern of those about to believe on him to life age-during:
translations.web: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

translations.kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: and to the King of the ages, the incorruptible, invisible, only wise God, is honour and glory--to the ages of the ages! Amen.
translations.web: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

translations.kjv: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
translations.ylt: This charge I commit to thee, child Timotheus, according to the prophesies that went before upon thee, that thou mayest war in them the good warfare,
translations.web: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

translations.kjv: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
translations.ylt: having faith and a good conscience, which certain having thrust away, concerning the faith did make shipwreck,
translations.web: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

translations.kjv: Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
translations.ylt: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I did deliver to the Adversary, that they might be instructed not to speak evil.
translations.web: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

translations.kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
translations.ylt: I exhort, then, first of all, there be made supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, for all men:
translations.web: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

translations.kjv: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
translations.ylt: for kings, and all who are in authority, that a quiet and peaceable life we may lead in all piety and gravity,
translations.web: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

translations.kjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
translations.ylt: for this is right and acceptable before God our Saviour,
translations.web: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

translations.kjv: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
translations.ylt: who doth will all men to be saved, and to come to the full knowledge of the truth;
translations.web: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

translations.kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
translations.ylt: for one is God, one also is mediator of God and of men, the man Christ Jesus,
translations.web: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

translations.kjv: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
translations.ylt: who did give himself a ransom for all--the testimony in its own times--
translations.web: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

translations.kjv: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
translations.ylt: in regard to which I was set a preacher and apostle--truth I say in Christ, I do not lie--a teacher of nations, in faith and truth.
translations.web: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

translations.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
translations.ylt: I wish, therefore, that men pray in every place, lifting up kind hands, apart from anger and reasoning;
translations.web: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

translations.kjv: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
translations.ylt: in like manner also the women, in becoming apparel, with modesty and sobriety to adorn themselves, not in braided hair, or gold, or pearls, or garments of great price,
translations.web: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

translations.kjv: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
translations.ylt: but--which becometh women professing godly piety--through good works.
translations.web: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

translations.kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
translations.ylt: Let a woman in quietness learn in all subjection,
translations.web: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

translations.kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
translations.ylt: and a woman I do not suffer to teach, nor to rule a husband, but to be in quietness,
translations.web: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

translations.kjv: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
translations.ylt: for Adam was first formed, then Eve,
translations.web: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

translations.kjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
translations.ylt: and Adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been deceived, into transgression came,
translations.web: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

translations.kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
translations.ylt: and she shall be saved through the child-bearing, if they remain in faith, and love, and sanctification, with sobriety.
translations.web: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

translations.kjv: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
translations.ylt: Stedfast is the word: If any one the oversight doth long for, a right work he desireth;
translations.web: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

translations.kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
translations.ylt: it behoveth, therefore, the overseer to be blameless, of one wife a husband, vigilant, sober, decent, a friend of strangers, apt to teach,
translations.web: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

translations.kjv: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
translations.ylt: not given to wine, not a striker, not given to filthy lucre, but gentle, not contentious, not a lover of money,
translations.web: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

translations.kjv: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
translations.ylt: his own house leading well, having children in subjection with all gravity,
translations.web: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

translations.kjv: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
translations.ylt: (and if any one his own house how to lead hath not known, how an assembly of God shall he take care of?)
translations.web: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

translations.kjv: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
translations.ylt: not a new convert, lest having been puffed up he may fall to a judgment of the devil;
translations.web: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

translations.kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
translations.ylt: and it behoveth him also to have a good testimony from those without, that he may not fall into reproach and a snare of the devil.
translations.web: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

translations.kjv: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
translations.ylt: Ministrants--in like manner grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not given to filthy lucre,
translations.web: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

translations.kjv: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
translations.ylt: having the secret of the faith in a pure conscience,
translations.web: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

translations.kjv: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
translations.ylt: and let these also first be proved, then let them minister, being unblameable.
translations.web: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

translations.kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
translations.ylt: Women--in like manner grave, not false accusers, vigilant, faithful in all things.
translations.web: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

translations.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
translations.ylt: Ministrants--let them be of one wife husbands; the children leading well, and their own houses,
translations.web: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

translations.kjv: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: for those who did minister well a good step to themselves do acquire, and much boldness in faith that is in Christ Jesus.
translations.web: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
translations.ylt: These things I write to thee, hoping to come unto thee soon,
translations.web: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

translations.kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
translations.ylt: and if I delay, that thou mayest know how it behoveth thee to conduct thyself in the house of God, which is an assembly of the living God--a pillar and foundation of the truth,
translations.web: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

translations.kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
translations.ylt: and, confessedly, great is the secret of piety--God was manifested in flesh, declared righteous in spirit, seen by messengers, preached among nations, believed on in the world, taken up in glory!
translations.web: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

translations.kjv: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
translations.ylt: And the Spirit expressly speaketh, that in latter times shall certain fall away from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and teachings of demons,
translations.web: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

translations.kjv: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
translations.ylt: in hypocrisy speaking lies, being seared in their own conscience,
translations.web: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

translations.kjv: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
translations.ylt: forbidding to marry--to abstain from meats that God created to be received with thanksgiving by those believing and acknowledging the truth,
translations.web: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

translations.kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
translations.ylt: because every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, with thanksgiving being received,
translations.web: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

translations.kjv: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
translations.ylt: for it is sanctified through the word of God and intercession.
translations.web: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

translations.kjv: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
translations.ylt: These things placing before the brethren, thou shalt be a good ministrant of Jesus Christ, being nourished by the words of the faith, and of the good teaching, which thou didst follow after,
translations.web: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

translations.kjv: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
translations.ylt: and the profane and old women's fables reject thou, and exercise thyself unto piety,
translations.web: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

translations.kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
translations.ylt: for the bodily exercise is unto little profit, and the piety is to all things profitable, a promise having of the life that now is, and of that which is coming;
translations.web: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

translations.kjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
translations.ylt: stedfast is the word, and of all acceptation worthy;
translations.web: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

translations.kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
translations.ylt: for for this we both labour and are reproached, because we hope on the living God, who is Saviour of all men--especially of those believing.
translations.web: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

translations.kjv: These things command and teach.
translations.ylt: Charge these things, and teach;
translations.web: Command and teach these things.

translations.kjv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
translations.ylt: let no one despise thy youth, but a pattern become thou of those believing in word, in behaviour, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity;
translations.web: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

translations.kjv: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
translations.ylt: till I come, give heed to the reading, to the exhortation, to the teaching;
translations.web: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

translations.kjv: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
translations.ylt: be not careless of the gift in thee, that was given thee through prophecy, with laying on of the hands of the eldership;
translations.web: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

translations.kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
translations.ylt: of these things be careful; in these things be, that thy advancement may be manifest in all things;
translations.web: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

translations.kjv: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
translations.ylt: take heed to thyself, and to the teaching; remain in them, for this thing doing, both thyself thou shalt save, and those hearing thee.
translations.web: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

translations.kjv: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
translations.ylt: An aged person thou mayest not rebuke, but be entreating as a father; younger persons as brethren;
translations.web: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

translations.kjv: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
translations.ylt: aged women as mothers, younger ones as sisters--in all purity;
translations.web: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

translations.kjv: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
translations.ylt: honour widows who are really widows;
translations.web: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

translations.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
translations.ylt: and if any widow have children or grandchildren, let them learn first to their own house to show piety, and to give back a recompense to the parents, for this is right and acceptable before God.
translations.web: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

translations.kjv: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
translations.ylt: And she who is really a widow and desolate, hath hoped upon God, and doth remain in the supplications and in the prayers night and day,
translations.web: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

translations.kjv: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
translations.ylt: and she who is given to luxury, living--hath died;
translations.web: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

translations.kjv: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
translations.ylt: and these things charge, that they may be blameless;
translations.web: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

translations.kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
translations.ylt: and if any one for his own--and especially for those of the household--doth not provide, the faith he hath denied, and than an unbeliever he is worse.
translations.web: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

translations.kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
translations.ylt: A widow--let her not be enrolled under sixty years of age, having been a wife of one husband,
translations.web: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

translations.kjv: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
translations.ylt: in good works being testified to: if she brought up children, if she entertained strangers, if saints' feet she washed, if those in tribulation she relieved, if every good work she followed after;
translations.web: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

translations.kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
translations.ylt: and younger widows be refusing, for when they may revel against the Christ, they wish to marry,
translations.web: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

translations.kjv: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
translations.ylt: having judgment, because the first faith they did cast away,
translations.web: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

translations.kjv: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
translations.ylt: and at the same time also, they learn to be idle, going about the houses; and not only idle, but also tattlers and busybodies, speaking the things they ought not;
translations.web: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

translations.kjv: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
translations.ylt: I wish, therefore, younger ones to marry, to bear children, to be mistress of the house, to give no occasion to the opposer to reviling;
translations.web: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

translations.kjv: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
translations.ylt: for already certain did turn aside after the Adversary.
translations.web: For already some have turned away after Satan.

translations.kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
translations.ylt: If any believing man or believing woman have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the assembly be burdened, that those really widows it may relieve.
translations.web: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

translations.kjv: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
translations.ylt: The well-leading elders of double honour let them be counted worthy, especially those labouring in word and teaching,
translations.web: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

translations.kjv: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
translations.ylt: for the Writing saith, `An ox treading out thou shalt not muzzle,' and `Worthy is the workman of his reward.'
translations.web: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

translations.kjv: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
translations.ylt: Against an elder an accusation receive not, except upon two or three witnesses.
translations.web: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

translations.kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
translations.ylt: Those sinning, reprove before all, that the others also may have fear;
translations.web: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

translations.kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
translations.ylt: I testify fully, before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the choice messengers, that these things thou mayest keep, without forejudging, doing nothing by partiality.
translations.web: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

translations.kjv: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
translations.ylt: Be laying hands quickly on no one, nor be having fellowship with sins of others; be keeping thyself pure;
translations.web: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

translations.kjv: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.
translations.ylt: no longer be drinking water, but a little wine be using, because of thy stomach and of thine often infirmities;
translations.web: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

translations.kjv: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
translations.ylt: of certain men the sins are manifest beforehand, leading before to judgment, and certain also they follow after;
translations.web: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

translations.kjv: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
translations.ylt: in like manner also the right works are manifest beforehand, and those that are otherwise are not able to be hid.
translations.web: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

translations.kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
translations.ylt: As many as are servants under a yoke, their own masters worthy of all honour let them reckon, that the name of God and the teaching may not be evil spoken of;
translations.web: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

translations.kjv: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
translations.ylt: and those having believing masters, let them not slight them, because they are brethren, but rather let them serve, because they are stedfast and beloved, who of the benefit are partaking. These things be teaching and exhorting;
translations.web: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

translations.kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
translations.ylt: if any one be teaching otherwise, and do not consent to sound words--those of our Lord Jesus Christ--and to the teaching according to piety,
translations.web: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

translations.kjv: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
translations.ylt: he is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and word-striving, out of which doth come envy, strife, evil-speakings, evil-surmisings,
translations.web: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

translations.kjv: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
translations.ylt: wranglings of men wholly corrupted in mind, and destitute of the truth, supposing the piety to be gain; depart from such;
translations.web: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

translations.kjv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
translations.ylt: but it is great gain--the piety with contentment;
translations.web: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

translations.kjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
translations.ylt: for nothing did we bring into the world-- it is manifest that we are able to carry nothing out;
translations.web: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

translations.kjv: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
translations.ylt: but having food and raiment--with these we shall suffice ourselves;
translations.web: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

translations.kjv: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
translations.ylt: and those wishing to be rich, do fall into temptation and a snare, and many desires, foolish and hurtful, that sink men into ruin and destruction,
translations.web: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

translations.kjv: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
translations.ylt: for a root of all the evils is the love of money, which certain longing for did go astray from the faith, and themselves did pierce through with many sorrows;
translations.web: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

translations.kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
translations.ylt: and thou, O man of God, these things flee, and pursue righteousness, piety, faith, love, endurance, meekness;
translations.web: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

translations.kjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
translations.ylt: be striving the good strife of the faith, be laying hold on the life age-during, to which also thou wast called, and didst profess the right profession before many witnesses.
translations.web: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

translations.kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
translations.ylt: I charge thee, before God, who is making all things alive, and of Christ Jesus, who did testify before Pontius Pilate the right profession,
translations.web: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

translations.kjv: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
translations.ylt: that thou keep the command unspotted, unblameable, till the manifestation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
translations.web: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

translations.kjv: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
translations.ylt: which in His own times He shall shew--the blessed and only potentate, the King of the kings and Lord of the lords,
translations.web: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

translations.kjv: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
translations.ylt: who only is having immortality, dwelling in light unapproachable, whom no one of men did see, nor is able to see, to whom is honour and might age-during! Amen.
translations.web: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

translations.kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
translations.ylt: Those rich in the present age charge thou not to be high-minded, nor to hope in the uncertainty of riches, but in the living God, who is giving to us all things richly for enjoyment; --
translations.web: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

translations.kjv: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
translations.ylt: to do good, to be rich in good works, to be ready to impart, willing to communicate,
translations.web: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

translations.kjv: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
translations.ylt: treasuring up to themselves a right foundation for the time to come, that they may lay hold on the life age-during.
translations.web: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

translations.kjv: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
translations.ylt: O Timotheus, the thing entrusted guard thou, avoiding the profane vain-words and opposition of the falsely-named knowledge,
translations.web: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

translations.kjv: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen. The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.
translations.ylt: which certain professing--concerning the faith did swerve; the grace is with you. Amen.
translations.web: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
